name: Secret Santa
summary: Draw names for a gift exchange without an account.
description:
Add the people in your group, draw once, and get a private list of who buys for whom. Names and pairs live in this app's own SQLite database on your celld node. Nothing leaves the machine.

A tiny demo app for the Hamstr Store; it shows the whole lifecycle: a worker, a Durable Object, no static build step and no network permission.
